simple.meaning: חָוַר (châvar) is a Hebrew action word meaning “to blanch (as with shame).” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 1 time in Isaiah, beginning at Isaiah 29:22. Its meaning becomes clearer as the uses are compared.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to חָוַר (H2357) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: חָוַר (châvar) / H2357 is traced through Isaiah 29:22 with source-language evidence and verse context.
